tables.title: Table A-1: U.S. MD-Granting Medical School Applications and Matriculants by School, State of Legal Residence, and Gender, Academic Year 2025-2026
tables.description: The table below displays the number of 2025-2026 applications and matriculants by U.S. MD-granting medical schools, showing the percent of in state, out of state, women, and men. Please email datarequest@aamc.org if you need further assistance or have additional inquiries.
